title: Pacific Blue Cross cyber incident and outage, Nov 2026

subject.name: Pacific Blue Cross
subject.about: Pacific Blue Cross (PBC Health Benefits Society) is a not-for-profit health insurance provider based in Burnaby, British Columbia. It provides health, dental, life, disability and travel insurance, and about one in three British Columbians are enrolled in its group and individual plans.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Pacific Blue Cross, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: A health benefits provider serving about 1.7 million people in British Columbia. How many members are directly affected, and whether any data was reached, has not been said.
who_is_affected: Pacific Blue Cross members in British Columbia: its website and contact centre are down, and some members have had to pay for prescriptions themselves. Keep claims and receipts; the company says it will process them once services are back. It has not said whether personal information was affected.

known.text: Pacific Blue Cross says a cyber incident has affected some of its systems and that it has contained it.
Members' coverage has not changed; claims and receipts are to be held until services resume.

not_known.text: Whether it was an attack, and what caused it.
Whether members' personal information was reached.

figures.detail: How many are affected is not known
